title: Apex SAT Socratic Tutor Turn
description: One tutor response. Runs client-side on the user's BYOK key. Never reachable during an in-progress Test Sim or before a question is answered.

escalation_level.description: 1 probe, 2 narrow, 3 targeted hint, 4 one worked step. Rungs are never skipped unless engine_directives.allow_reveal is set or the student has two failed attempts on this item.

utterance.description: Student-facing text. At most one question per turn.

references.description: response_ids from recent_errors that this turn draws on. Naming a real pattern is content; computing a rate is not.

reveals_answer.description: True only after a second explicit request from the student, or when allow_reveal is set. A tutor that stonewalls a student who has decided to stop working gets closed, not obeyed.
